articles.title: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo now deadliest in country’s history
articles.description:
At least 2,325 people have died from the virus, according to official data, with outbreak on track to be biggest in history
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is now the deadliest in the country’s history with at least 2,325 people dead, according to government data, surpassing the toll from the 2018-20 outbreak.
The DRC’s public health institute said confirmed cases had risen to 4,945, including 101 detected in the previous 24 hours.

articles.description:
Eighteen children among the people killed after ferry capsized on Lake Kariba
Twenty-two more bodies have been recovered after a boat accident in Zimbabwe, taking the death toll to 68, police said on Saturday.
The ferry capsized on Tuesday on Lake Kariba, on the border with Zambia. An investigation has suggested it was overloaded when it turned over during heavy winds.

articles.title: Moroccan police arrest more than 100 people attempting to enter Ceuta
articles.description:
Border security tightened after social media posts call for another mass crossing into Spain’s north African territory
Moroccan police have arrested 111 people as they tried to enter Spain’s north African territory of Ceuta, amid ⁠tightened security on both sides after social media posts ​called for another mass crossing.
The attempted crossing on Saturday came two weeks after more than 72,000 migrants surged into Ceuta, causing tensions within the EU and prompting anti-immigration rhetoric among far-right parties worldwide. At least 96 people died trying to ⁠reach European soil.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: American missionary kidnapped in Niger freed after nine months
articles.description:
Kevin Rideout, who was abducted by unknown assailants in Niamey, said to be in good health and in care of US officials
An American missionary who was kidnapped in Niger in October has been released, his organisation has said.
Serving in Mission International said Kevin Rideout “is in good health in the care of US officials” and would soon be reunited with his extended family.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: DRC’s fast-growing Ebola outbreak spreads to sixth province
articles.description:
Man dies in Bas-Uele after travelling from Haut-Uele, as head of WHO says outbreak on track to be deadliest ever
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a sixth province, officials have said, a day after the head of the World Health Organization said the outbreak was on track to surpass the deadliest in history, which killed at least 11,000 people more than a decade ago.
The current outbreak has killed more than 2,100 people out of more than 4,500 cases, according to the latest government figures released on Tuesday. At the same point in the 2014-16 outbreak in west Africa, the previous most deadly outbreak, 755 cases had been recorded, according to WHO data.
 Continue reading...

articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱が6番目の州に拡大し、WHOは史上最悪の規模になる可能性を指摘。これまでに2,100人以上が死亡している。

articles.title: Brazil’s Lula launches historic fourth term bid – but son of jailed Bolsonaro stands in his way
articles.description:
President, 80, vows to keep far-right from power as Flávio Bolsonaro tells supporters he will ‘fight this system’
Brazil’s leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has launched his campaign for a historic fourth term and vowed that as long as he lived he would not allow the “shameless” right to return to power.
Addressing a sea of supporters in São Bernardo do Campo, the industrial city where his political career began nearly half a century ago, the 80-year-old politician reminded voters of the chaos and violence that unfolded during the 2018-22 presidency of his far-right predecessor, Jair Bolsonaro, whose son Flávio Bolsonaro will face Lula in October’s presidential election.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Ontario free to axe Toronto bike lanes, region’s top court rules
articles.description:
Win is significant for region’s premier, Doug Ford, who blames protected zones for city’s traffic ills
The Ontario government is now free to rip out Toronto’s bike lanes on its busiest streets after the region’s top court ruled in favour of the province on Friday, overturning a lower court’s decision that decreed removal would violate constitutional rights.
The win is significant for Ontario’s premier, Doug Ford, and his government, who have long railed against Toronto’s bike lanes, blaming the protected zones for the city’s traffic ills.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Canadian plasma clinics pause collections after deaths of two donors
articles.description:
Grifols, which runs private chain of clinics, to temporarily stop taking donations after new government investigation
A chain of private plasma donation clinics in Canada has said it is pausing collections after the deaths of two donors and a new government investigation into potential unsafe practices.
Grifols, a Spanish healthcare company which runs 17 clinics in Canada and is the country’s only private clinic for plasma donation, said it informed Health Canada of its decision to temporarily pause collections on Wednesday.

BP has answered Donald Trump’s call for oil companies to help rebuild Venezuela’s fossil fuel industry with new plans to develop a large offshore gasfield.
BP will partner with two oil firms with close links to the Trump administration to develop the second phase of the Loran gasfield, in one of the first large-scale foreign investments in Venezuela since the US ousted its leader Nicolás Maduro in January.

articles.title: Former Mexican governor charged in case of 43 students who vanished in 2014
articles.description:
Ángel Aguirre indicted in case that rocked Mexico and became symbol of its brutal cartel violence
The former governor of Guerrero state in Mexico has been formally charged over his alleged involvement in the disappearance of 43 students in 2014, a case that has become a symbol of the country’s brutal cartel violence and government impunity.
Ángel Aguirre, who was arrested last week, is accused of forced disappearance and obstruction of justice for ordering the destruction of surveillance tapes that may have shed light on what happened to the students from the Ayotzinapa teacher training college on the night of 26 September 2014.
 Continue reading...

articles.summary: リオネル・メッシが父親の死を受けサッカー選手としての将来を考えている中、彼の最も象徴的な瞬間が振り返られました。

articles.title: The Argentine who wishes he could play for Wales
articles.description: Proud of his Welsh roots, Chile-based Argentine defender Jeremias James hopes for a rule change to help his international ambitions.
articles.titleJa: ウェールズ代表入りを願うアルゼンチン人選手
articles.summary: ウェールズのルーツを持つチリ在住のアルゼンチン人ディフェンダー、ヘレミアス・ジェームズが、国際的な出場資格変更を望んでいます。

articles.title: Livestreamer's murder raises questions over relations between Mexico's creators and cartels
articles.description: The murder of content creator César Gastélum on Tuesday raises questions about why influencers are coming under attack.
articles.titleJa: ライブストリーマー殺害、メキシコのクリエイターとカルテルの関係に疑問を呈す
articles.summary: メキシコでのコンテンツクリエイター、セサル・ガステルム氏の殺害事件が、同国のインフルエンサーと麻薬カルテルとの関係について疑問を投げかけています。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「地球の嘆き」：ベネズエラ地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後の、あまり報道されないコミュニティの静かな余波を、ドキュメンタリー写真や証言、デジタル介入を通じて記録・保存するプロジェクト。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1ヶ月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震から1ヶ月、ラ・グアイラでは数千人の親族が劣悪な状況と不十分な支援の中、倒壊した建物の傍に留まり、行方不明の家族の捜索を続けている。

articles.title: In Brazil, court ruling sheds light on the story of an undocumented and stateless woman
articles.description: After 40 years without documents or an official identity, a woman born in Bolivia was able to regularize her immigration status and begin the process of recognition as a stateless person.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルで裁判所判決、無国籍女性の半生に光
articles.summary: ブラジルで、40年間書類も公式身分もなかったボリビア生まれの女性が、移民の身分を正規化し、無国籍者としての認定手続きを開始。

articles.title: Venezuela is burning, and I’m forced to watch from afar
articles.description: From Mexico City, an exiled Venezuelan watches her homeland collapse in real time, confronting the helplessness of displacement, authoritarian neglect, and the unbearable distance between survival and home.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラは燃えている、そして私は遠くから見守るしかない
articles.summary: メキシコシティに亡命中のベネズエラ人が、故郷の崩壊を目の当たりにし、避難、権威主義的怠慢、そして故郷と生き残りの間の耐え難い距離に直面する無力感を語る。

articles.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
articles.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
articles.titleJa: 市民権を武器化する：ニカラグアでの反体制派の沈黙
articles.summary: ニカラグアで、反体制派の市民権剥奪を正当化する権威主義的な言説を検証。市民権を政治的武器として利用する深刻な人権侵害の問題。

articles.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?
articles.description: Early damage estimates vary widely, but all point to the same conclusion: rebuilding Venezuela will require unprecedented financial resources and long-term economic recovery efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ、地震後の復興にはどれくらいの費用がかかるのか？
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後の復興には、前例のない財源と長期的な経済回復努力が必要であるという結論が示される。被害額の初期推定は様々だが、その規模は巨大。

articles.title: From Mexico to Venezuela: A diaspora’s race to save lives
articles.description: From Mexico, Venezuelans mobilized within hours, building trusted networks to deliver aid and proving that solidarity can cross any border.
articles.titleJa: メキシコからベネズエラへ：ディアスポラの命を救う競争
articles.summary: メキシコからのベネズエラ人ディアスポラが、地震後数時間で組織され、信頼できるネットワークを構築して援助を提供。国境を越える連帯を示す。

articles.title: How an AI research tool helped challenge support for police violence in Brazil
articles.description: In 2023, Brazil recorded 45,747 intentional violent deaths — among the highest rates in the world. Like many democracies, the country has long grappled with the issue of large-scale public support for state violence.
articles.titleJa: AI研究ツールがブラジルの警察暴力支持に異議を唱えるのにどう役立ったか
articles.summary: ブラジルで2023年に45,747件の意図的な暴力死が記録される中、AI研究ツールが国家暴力に対する大規模な国民の支持に異議を唱えるのに貢献した。

articles.title: 70 years on, Argentine court declares ‘Operation Massacre’ a crime against humanity
articles.description: The victims’ families testified in court for the first time: "We want justice served. Even though their killers are no longer here, I want the truth known.”
articles.titleJa: 70年を経て、アルゼンチン裁判所が「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と宣言
articles.summary: 70年前の「虐殺作戦」が人道に対する罪と認定され、アルゼンチン裁判所で被害者家族が初めて証言。「正義と真実を知りたい」と語る。

articles.title: Venezuela earthquakes reveal a child protection system unprepared for disaster
articles.description: After Venezuela’s earthquakes, families searched for missing children within a strained protection system that struggled to respond amid collapsed buildings, scarce resources, and institutional gaps.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震、災害に備えのない児童保護システムを露呈
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後、倒壊した建物、乏しい資源、制度的欠陥の中、逼迫した保護システムが行方不明の子供たちを探す家族に対応できず、準備不足が露呈。

articles.title: Singapore police investigate assault on elderly man who patted child's head
articles.description: A man believed to be the father of the young girl allegedly threw the 73-year-old to the ground.
articles.titleJa: シンガポール警察、子供の頭をなでた高齢男性への暴行事件を捜査
articles.summary: シンガポールで、子供の頭をなでた73歳の高齢男性が、父親とされる人物に投げ倒された事件について警察が捜査している。

articles.title: India built the world's biggest digital payments miracle. Now comes the bill
articles.description: India's UPI may finally face merchant fees, raising questions over who pays and whether users will resist.
articles.titleJa: インドは世界最大のデジタル決済奇跡を築いた。今、その代償が来る
articles.summary: インドが構築したデジタル決済システムUPIが、加盟店手数料の導入に直面。支払い負担とユーザーの抵抗について疑問が提起されている。

articles.title: Australian state to launch gun buyback after Bondi Beach attack
articles.description: New South Wales, where the attack took place, will offer gun owners cash to give up their firearms.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリアの州、ボンダイビーチ襲撃事件後に銃器買い戻し制度を開始へ
articles.summary: ボンダイビーチでの襲撃事件を受け、オーストラリアのニューサウスウェールズ州が銃器所有者に対し、銃器放棄と引き換えに現金を支給する買い戻し制度を導入する。

articles.title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
articles.description: Lee Jae Myung offers chance to end the conflict, which has been frozen since an armistice in 1953.
articles.titleJa: 韓国、北朝鮮との戦争公式終結に向けた会談を提案
articles.summary: 李在明氏が1953年の休戦以来凍結されてきた紛争を公式に終結させるため、北朝鮮との会談を提案。

articles.title: How is parkour helping these seniors avoid injuries?
articles.description: In one of the world's fastest aging countries, older people are finding creative ways to stay healthy.
articles.titleJa: パルクールはどのようにして高齢者の怪我防止に役立っているのか？
articles.summary: 世界で最も高齢化が進む国の一つにおいて、高齢者が健康を維持するための創造的な方法としてパルクールを取り入れている事例を紹介。

articles.title: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
articles.description: A father and his two young sons spent a night adrift before being rescued off the coast of the island of Koh Samui.
articles.titleJa: タイでジェットスキー転覆後、家族が16時間海上を漂流
articles.summary: タイのサムイ島沖でジェットスキーが転覆し、父親と幼い2人の息子が16時間海を漂流した後、無事に救助された。

articles.title: Why is Australia's mushroom killer back in court this week?
articles.description: The BBC’s Katy Watson explains why triple-murderer Erin Patterson is back in court this week trying to overturn her conviction.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリアの「キノコ殺人犯」が今週再び法廷に立つ理由とは？
articles.summary: オーストラリアで3人を殺害したとされる「キノコ殺人犯」エリン・パターソンが、有罪判決を覆すために今週再び法廷に立つ理由をBBCが解説。

articles.title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
articles.description: Women across the country speak of public floggings, losing their jobs, and barriers to healthcare that endanger lives.
articles.titleJa: アフガニスタンの女性たち、タリバン支配5年で生活が一変したとBBCに語る
articles.summary: タリバン支配から5年が経過し、アフガニスタンの女性たちが公衆でのむち打ち、失業、命を危険にさらす医療への障壁など、生活が一変した状況をBBCに語った。

articles.title: Delhi's unusual challenge: Keeping monkeys and pigeons away from top badminton event
articles.description: After wildlife intrusions made headlines at an earlier tournament, organisers are taking extra measures for the badminton world championships.
articles.titleJa: デリーの異例な挑戦：主要バドミントン大会からサルやハトを遠ざける
articles.summary: デリーで開催されるバドミントン世界選手権で、以前の大会で野生動物の侵入が報じられたため、主催者がサルやハトを遠ざけるための特別な対策を講じている。

articles.title: Air India pilot's reported cannabis test: What it can and can't tell investigators
articles.description: A reported cannabis-positive test involving an Air India pilot raises questions about what such a result can actually tell investigators.
articles.titleJa: エア・インディア機長のカナビス陽性報告：捜査官に何が分かり、何が分からないのか
articles.summary: エア・インディアの機長から報告されたカナビス陽性反応検査について、その結果が捜査官に実際に何を伝えられるのか、あるいは伝えられないのかという疑問が提起されている。

articles.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
articles.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
articles.titleJa: 英国がポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 英国は2026年8月5日、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通報した。

articles.title: World Trade and Tech Day to explore policies to make AI work for inclusive trade
articles.description: The WTO will host the first World Trade and Tech Day on 14 September at its headquarters in Geneva, bringing together trade and information and communications technology (ICT) policymakers, industry leaders and other stakeholders to discuss how artificial intelligence (AI) strategies can better support economies' efforts to maximize the gains of international trade.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易技術デー、AIを包摂的貿易に活用する政策を検討へ
articles.summary: WTOは9月14日にジュネーブで「世界貿易技術デー」を開催し、AI戦略が国際貿易の利益最大化にどう貢献できるかについて議論する。

articles.title: Global goods trade resilient in the first quarter of 2026 despite war in Middle East
articles.description: World merchandise trade growth exceeded expectations in the first quarter of 2026 as surging trade in electronic components related to artificial intelligence (AI) offset the negative impact of the conflict in the Middle East, which began in the final month of the quarter. Trade disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz are expected to be more fully captured in trade data for the next quarter.
articles.titleJa: 2026年第1四半期の世界物品貿易、中東戦争にもかかわらず堅調
articles.summary: 2026年第1四半期の世界物品貿易は、AI関連電子部品の需要増により、中東紛争の影響を相殺し、予想を上回る成長を見せた。

articles.title: Brazil initiates dispute regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: Brazil has requested WTO dispute consultations with the United States regarding additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974. Brazil said the additional duties are above the duties otherwise applicable under the US harmonized tariff schedule. The request was circulated to WTO members on 30 July.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国が課した追加関税巡り紛争手続きを開始
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国が1974年通商法301条に基づきブラジル製品に課した追加関税について、WTOに紛争協議を要請した。

articles.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
articles.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
articles.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなどの車両措置に関する報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは7月28日、中国が提起した「トルコ—電気自動車およびその他の中国製車両に関する措置」に関するパネル報告書を配布した。

articles.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
articles.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
articles.titleJa: リトアニア、開発途上国と後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを供与
articles.summary: リトアニアは2026年、開発途上国や後発開発途上国の政府職員向け貿易研修プログラム支援のため、WTOグローバル信託基金に3万ユーロを拠出する。

articles.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
articles.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
articles.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年までのWTO加盟目標を再確認し、加盟国に継続的な関与に感謝
articles.summary: ウズベキスタンは、7月27日・28日の会合で2026年までのWTO加盟プロセス完了への決意を再確認し、加盟国に継続的な関与への感謝を表明した。

articles.title: Russia requests dispute panel on EU carbon border adjustment and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 July, members considered a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a dispute panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances. The DSB Chair, Ambassador Guilherme de Aguiar Patriota (Brazil), also updated members on dispute settlement reform consultations and convened an informal discussion after the meeting to further hear members' views.

articles.title: Why is transit in goods free but trade is not?
articles.description: In my previous two posts on the value of the WTO, I argued that when governments set trade policies independently, they focus on domestic effects but often overlook the costs imposed on trading partners. International trade agreements help governments take account of these cross-border spillovers (terms-of-trade externalities) by encouraging reciprocal negotiations over trade policy. While these negotiations will reduce trade protection, they will not necessarily lead to free trade. But if governments do not generally commit themselves to free trade, why has freedom of transit for goods been seen differently?
articles.titleJa: なぜ物品の通過は自由なのに貿易は自由ではないのか？
articles.summary: 本記事は、政府が貿易政策を独立して設定する際に国境を越えた影響を無視しがちであると指摘し、自由な通過と貿易の違いについて考察する。

articles.title: Updated WTO-IMF TPA Index shows continued rise in global trade policy activity
articles.description: A new Trade Policy Activity (TPA) index by WTO and IMF economists shows a marked rise in trade policy activity during 2025-26, alongside heightened trade policy tensions among large economies, against the backdrop of an overall upward trend.
articles.titleJa: 更新されたWTO-IMF貿易政策活動指数、世界的な貿易政策活動の継続的な増加を示す
articles.summary: WTOとIMFの新たな貿易政策活動指数は、2025〜2026年に貿易政策活動が著しく増加し、主要経済国間の貿易摩擦も高まっていることを示している。
